mapper.sql: SELECT r.*, s.full_name AS student_name, t.full_name AS teacher_name FROM daily_reports r JOIN students s ON s.id = r.student_id JOIN users t ON t.id = r.teacher_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO daily_reports (student_id, teacher_id, report_date, summary, mood, status) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{teacherId}, #{reportDate}, #{summary}, #{mood}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE daily_reports SET report_date = #{reportDate}, summary = #{summary}, mood = #{mood} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE daily_reports SET status = 'PUBLISHED', published_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{reportId}
UPDATE daily_reports SET status = 'DRAFT', published_at = NULL WHERE id = #{reportId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM daily_reports WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND report_date = #{date} AND id <> #{excludeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO report_rubrics (report_id, criterion, rating, comment) VALUES (#{reportId}, #{criterion}, #{rating}, #{comment})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM report_rubrics WHERE report_id = #{reportId} ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO report_acknowledgements (report_id, parent_id) VALUES (#{reportId}, #{parentId})
mapper.select: SELECT acknowledged_at FROM report_acknowledgements WHERE report_id = #{reportId} AND parent_id = #{parentId}
SELECT MAX(acknowledged_at) FROM report_acknowledgements WHERE report_id = #{reportId}
